edits.old: International Water, a subsidiary of Bechtel with United Utilities, held 55% of Aguas del Tunari, the only bidder for the Cochabamba concession; Abengoa of Spain held 25% (Wikipedia).
edits.new: The ICSID tribunal's decision on jurisdiction of 21 October 2005 sets out the ownership as at September 1999 (para. 60): International Water (Tunari) Ltd of the Cayman Islands held 55% of Aguas del Tunari and was itself 100% owned by Bechtel Enterprise Holdings, Inc. of the United States; Riverstar International S.A. of Uruguay, 100% owned by Abengoa of Spain, held 25%; and four Bolivian companies held 5% each - Constructora Petricevic S.A., Compania Boliviana de Ingenieria S.R.L., ICE Agua y Energia S.A. and Sociedad Boliviana de Cemento S.A. Under an agreement of 9 November 1999 Edison S.p.A. of Italy was to take a 50% interest in International Water (Tunari) Ltd (para. 67). The decision does not mention United Utilities. In December 1999 the holding migrated to Luxembourg and then to a Dutch company, which is how the Netherlands-Bolivia treaty came into it (paras 70, 72).

edits.old: China Eximbank and Bank of China signed a syndicated loan with Barisal Electric Power Company Ltd for the US$557.89 million plant in September 2021, according to AidData's current record. Energy Transition Bangladesh, citing AidData's 2023 record, says China Eximbank and the Beijing and Singapore branches of Bank of China signed a US$427.5 million loan in April 2020;
edits.new: AidData's record for the project, read on 11 November 2026, gives one syndicated loan facility of US$427.5 million signed in April 2020 (commitment date 1 April 2020) by China Eximbank with the Beijing and Singapore branches of Bank of China Limited, to Barisal Electric Power Company Ltd; AidData divides it equally at US$142.5 million each and says that split warrants further investigation. The US$557.89 million is the cost of the whole independent power plant project, not the loan. An earlier version of this card dated the signing to September 2021 and read the April 2020 loan as a separate one; both came from the same record.

edits.old: Global Energy Monitor reports that the syndicate issued its first loan in May 2021, completing the financing.
edits.new: Global Energy Monitor reports that the syndicate issued its first loan in May 2021, completing the financing; that page could not be opened to check, and AidData's record gives no disbursement date. With the facility signed in April 2020 and the sovereign guarantee given on 23 December 2020, a first issuance in May 2021 does not conflict with the signing date.

edits.new: The Jakarta Post gave the plant's share as 30% of Batam's 383 MW demand; Kompas gave 26%. On capacity the two figures are measuring different things rather than disagreeing: PT TJK Power's own site gives the plant as 2 x 65 MW, 130 MW installed, which is the figure AidData uses, while PLN Batam's president director gave its daya mampu, the capacity it can actually deliver, as 2 x 55 MW at a press conference on 4 November 2021. TJK Power is a joint venture of PT Petra Unggul Sejahtera and PT PLN Batam, Petra Unggul Sejahtera being a partnership of China Huadian Engineering Co. Ltd, PT Inta Daya Perkasa and Batam Power Ventures Pte Ltd; its site dates the two units' commercial operation to 25 October and 1 November 2012.

edits.old: The Bank says its role was only supervisory work under a contract that ended before the oil palm investment.
edits.new: The Bank says its role was only supervisory work under a contract that ended before the oil palm investment. IFAD's own evaluation gives the financing of the first phase as a US$20 million IFAD loan of April 1997 with private and government cofinancing, names no World Bank or IDA money, and records the Bank as the project's cooperating institution only until August 2004, when UNOPS took over and the Bank withdrew over its forestry safeguards policy. A search of the World Bank projects API for Uganda with oil palm, Kalangala or vegetable oil returns nothing. The case still carries a World Bank lender key, which is under review.
